name: Suzumemo (kakeibo)
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install; nvm use; nvm alias default "$(cat .nvmrc)"; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@11.1.2 --activate; BIN="$(dirname "$(nvm which current)")"; for b in node npm npx corepack pnpm; do [ -e "$BIN/$b" ] && ln -sf "$BIN/$b" "/usr/local/cargo/bin/$b" 2>/dev/null || true; done; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
